import os,sys,time,json,hashlib,types
from pathlib import Path
runtime,source_sha,plan,plan_sha,admission,admit_sha,destination,gate=sys.argv[1:]
def ident(s):return(s.st_dev,s.st_ino,s.st_size,s.st_mtime_ns,s.st_ctime_ns,s.st_nlink,s.st_mode)
p=Path(runtime);before=ident(p.lstat());assert before[5]==1
fd=os.open(p,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_NOFOLLOW)
try:
 assert ident(os.fstat(fd))==before
 b=b''
 while len(b)<=52459:
  chunk=os.read(fd,65536)
  if not chunk:break
  b+=chunk
 assert ident(os.fstat(fd))==before==ident(p.lstat())
finally:os.close(fd)
assert len(b)==52459 and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==source_sha
m=types.ModuleType('trace_delivery_frozen');m.__file__=runtime;sys.modules[m.__name__]=m;exec(compile(b,runtime,'exec'),m.__dict__)
a=m.pin_read(dict(path=admission,sha256=admit_sha,bytes=Path(admission).stat().st_size),m.Limits().metadata);decision=json.loads(a);assert decision['decision']=='ADMITTED' and decision['CPU_LOCAL_BOUNDED_BUILD'] is True
assert decision['plan']['sha256']==plan_sha and decision['resident_runtime']['sha256']==source_sha
assert os.environ['CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES']=='' and all(os.environ[k]=='1' for k in ('OMP_NUM_THREADS','OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS','MKL_NUM_THREADS'))
print(json.dumps(dict(waiting_for_main_live_verification=True,pid=os.getpid(),invocation=os.environ['INVOCATION_ID'],torch_imported='torch' in sys.modules,model_or_metric_imported=False)),flush=True)
deadline=time.monotonic()+60
while not Path(gate).exists():
 if time.monotonic()>deadline:raise TimeoutError('Main live verification gate not released')
 time.sleep(.05)
g=json.loads(Path(gate).read_bytes());assert g['live_verified'] is True and g['manual_once_dispatched'] is True and g['pid']==os.getpid() and g['invocation']==os.environ['INVOCATION_ID'] and g['plan_sha256']==plan_sha
result=m.build(dict(path=plan,sha256=plan_sha,bytes=Path(plan).stat().st_size),Path(destination))
print(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
